topic: Lean 4 executable semantics and recursive definitions for developer correctness QA

method.description: Searched the official Lean 4 reference and opened the Recursive Definitions page.

source.title: Recursive Definitions
source.authority: Primary language documentation maintained by the Lean project; authoritative for documented Lean recursive-definition and termination behavior.

source_claims.claim: Elaboration of recursive definitions produces a justification that the function is safe.
Structurally recursive functions call recursively only on strict subcomponents of the selected argument, and Lean elaborates this recursion using the argument's recursor.
An explicit termination_by structural annotation documents the decreasing parameter and prevents accidental use of well-founded recursion.

proposal_inference: Create an isolated Lean developer QA target with inductive bounded AST types, structurally recursive executable semantics where applicable, and kernel-checked correspondence lemmas against named Sherlock circuit/reference observations. Keep it out of the public runtime and prover path.
limitation: Lean's structural-recursion analysis is syntactic and may reject terminating functions; well-founded recursion covers a broader class (section 7.6.1, lines 215-217). The source does not establish implementation correctness or Clean/Lean correspondence.
